sources.title: GLM-5.3-CYBERSECURITY-FP8: Text-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: It is a cybersecurity-focused CRACK release from dealignai, based on JANGQ-AI/GLM-5.3-FP8, an FP8 quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3. The base has 753B total parameters, a glm_moe_dsaarchitecture, 78 layers, and text-only input and output. The model supports a 131,072-token maximum context in the documented deployment configuration.
